module_summary: HDLC-style serial bit-stream monitor: an encoded Moore FSM counts consecutive ones and decodes stuffed-bit discard, flag and error indications from its state.

anchors.name: cur
anchors.why: Encoded state counting consecutive ones, plus discard/flag/overflow states

anchors.name: disc
anchors.why: Decoded DRP state: stuffed zero after five ones to discard

anchors.name: flag
anchors.why: Decoded MRK state: flag pattern (six ones then zero) detected

anchors.name: err
anchors.why: Decoded OVF state: seven or more consecutive ones error

groups.name: Bit-stream FSM
groups.description: Ones-run FSM with Moore-decoded discard, flag and error outputs
